title: qaidi hu mai babajan
body:
qaidi hun mein baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
ab shaahzaadi kahaan
<<MINI>>
qaidi hun mein baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
ab shaahzaadi kahaan
na apna wo ghar hai na apna madina
wo baahein tchachaa ki tumhaara wo sinaa
bolo khudaara tum ho kahaan mein kahaan
<<MINI>>
qaidi hun mein baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
jis din se tumse judaa ho gayi hun
dekho to baba mein kya ho gayi hun
ujra makaan hai rehti hun ab mein jahaan
<<MINI>>
qaidi hun mein baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti na thi dekho na jaawo baba
taras khaawo mujh par taras khaao baba
tum kya gaye ho mujh par ghira aasmaan
<<MINI>>
qaidi hun mein baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
jaise hi neze pe tum aaye baba
maine tamaache bohot khaaye baba
rukhsaar par hain abhi tak sitam ke nishaan
<<MINI>>
qaidi hun mein baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
maanga kaneezi me baba kisi ne
phenka meri samt sadqa kisi ne
paidal chali hun kaanton ke mein darmyaan
<<MINI>>
qaidi hun mein baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
milne ko ham se tchale aawo baba
ek baar tchehra dikha jaawo baba
ay pyaare baba phir ham kahaan tu kahaan
<<MINI>>
qaidi hun mein baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
tchalo shaam tchalte hain rehan o sarwar
vahaan dekhna kya hai tchehlum ka manzar
bibi sakina karti hai ab tak fughaan
<<MINI>>
qaidi hun mein baba jaan
<<DIVIDER>>
ab shaazaadi kahaan
